map.由账户权益与持仓市值求保证金比例 使用指南: Margin Ratio from Account Equity and Position Market Value User Guide
map.输入账户权益与持仓市值，按保证金比例 = 权益 / 持仓市值 计算，用于监控融资: Enter account equity and position market value and compute margin ratio = equity / position market value, for monitoring margin usage and risk in margin trading or futures accounts.
map.保证金比例 = 权益/持仓市值 × 100%: Margin ratio = equity / position market value × 100%
map.输入账户权益与持仓市值，求保证金比例。: Enter account equity and position market value to get the margin ratio.
map.融资买入（或期货保证金）所需冻结资金 = 持仓市值 × 保证金率。: Frozen funds needed for margin buying (or futures margin) = position market value × margin rate.
map.券商/交易所维持保证金与初始保证金测算。: Maintenance margin and initial margin estimation for brokers and exchanges.
map.杠杆倍数 = 1/保证金率 的换算。: Conversion for leverage multiple = 1 / margin rate.
map.：保证金 = 10 万 × 50% = 5 万。杠杆 = 1/50% = 2 倍: : margin = 100,000 × 50% = 50,000. Leverage = 1/50% = 2x. If the margin rate is 100% (no leverage) the full 100,000 is required.
map.：初始保证金 50%、维持 30%：市值跌到使权益<30% 持仓市值时触发追保，: : initial margin 50%, maintenance 30%: when the market value drops so that equity falls below 30% of position market value, a margin call is triggered and you must top up.
map.由价格峰值与谷值求最大回撤: Maximum Drawdown from Price Peak and Trough
map.初始为开仓冻结比例，维持为最低权益比例，低于则追保/强平。: Initial is the frozen ratio to open a position, maintenance is the minimum equity ratio; below it comes a margin call or forced liquidation.
map.保证金率越低杠杆越高？: Does a lower margin rate mean higher leverage?
map.是。保证金率 10% 对应 10 倍杠杆，风险与收益同步放大，强平线更近。: Yes. A 10% margin rate means 10x leverage; risk and reward amplify together and the liquidation line is closer.
